subject.title: fix(signal): restore native replies for Signal sends

question: Should Signal adopt this channel-local `replyToId` alias and seven-day bounded group reply-author store once the current-main conflict is resolved?
rationale: The implementation appears technically sound, but its permanent delivery contract, persisted sender metadata, and retention/fallback behavior require maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the Signal-local contract
options.body: Resolve conflicts, verify the exact merged head, and land the bounded plugin-owned state and reply alias.

options.title: Require live Signal smoke
options.body: Hold merge until a real Signal daemon/device demonstrates direct and group native replies with redacted evidence.

options.title: Defer the reply direction
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers want a different cross-channel reply contract instead of this Signal-specific path.

recommendation.title: Accept the Signal-local contract
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, verify the exact merged head, and land the bounded plugin-owned state and reply alias.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent main history shows broad ownership of the overlapping Signal channel, session-routing, and inbound lifecycle surfaces.
